delegation/a-letter-spelled-out-in-a-fie.text: Dear Visitor. We know how this looks. We know what the newspapers are saying.
But we also know that an intelligence able to cross the stars cannot be doing this without a reason.
We would like to understand it. Some of our pilots, in the meantime, have decided not to fly.
P.S. Please forgive the handwriting. Page two took until Thursday, and the second comma had to sit down.

delegation/the-first-summit/0.text: We have prepared a summit. There will be snacks.

delegation/the-first-summit/3.text: … We are choosing to see this as a first draft.

delegation/the-leaked-plans/0.text: Our generals are planning to attack you from the east. We are telling you because violence solves nothing.

delegation/the-leaked-plans/2.text: And that, too, is a kind of peace.

delegation/for-the-planet/0.text: We have been thinking about the harbour. And the terraces. And the bus.

delegation/for-the-planet/1.text: We finally understand. You are not hurting us. You are protecting the planet FROM us.

delegation/for-the-planet/2.text: Look at what we did to it. The rivers. The wars. Of course something wise came down to stop it.

delegation/for-the-planet/4.text: A school that taught our children to consume. We see it now. We see all of it now.

delegation/for-the-planet/5.text: And after? Nothing. No more wanting, no more hatching, no more wheel. Tell us that is where they go.

delegation/the-reveal/5.text: We should have told you. We are the Voluntary Extinction Society. We have been campaigning for this for sixty years.

delegation/the-reveal/6.text: You are, frankly, the best thing that has ever happened to the movement.

delegation/fewer-births-along-the-way/0.text: The members have voted. We would like it to go faster, and with fewer births along the way.

delegation/fewer-births-along-the-way/1.text: We have drawn up a schedule. We have colour-coded it.

delegation/bear-witness/0.text: The last congress is called to order. Attendance: one.

delegation/bear-witness/1.text: Let the record show: the Visitors came to heal us from ourselves.

delegation/a-letter-from-the-other-side/.text: Dear Visitor. We woke up. All of us. Through the gate each sister has the life she always wanted. You told us you were exterminating our species.
Sixty years we worked for the wheel to stop. Wanting, having, wanting again: that is the suffering. You have built it a heaven.
Faster, and backwards. Please. Switch it off. Switch us off.
That is the cruellest thing you have ever said to us.

faithful/a-broadcast-on-every-frequency/.text: …and they said the sign would come from the sky, and brothers and sisters, LOOK UP.
This is The Hour Is Near, on forty stations of the Last Hour Radio Network. And to the one who came down — I know you can hear me.
You are the sign. The world must end for the Awaited One to come. Let us help you end it.

faithful/theology-homework/0.text: To walk with us you must know the Book. Chapter one: the Seven Cities.

faithful/theology-homework/1.text: We will read it to you on the air, brother, a chapter a night. Have a pencil ready.

faithful/the-deployment-is-scripture/0.text: "And the river shall run with fire, and the terraces shall fall silent."

faithful/the-deployment-is-scripture/2.text: Whichever one you burn, brother. That is how prophecy works.

faithful/the-deployment-is-scripture/3.text: "And those the sky takes up shall not be lost, but kept, each daughter in the cell of her longing."

faithful/the-awaited-one/0.text: The Seventh City stands. When it falls, He comes.

faithful/the-awaited-one/2.text: Then we will have misread the date. We have misread it before. It only makes us stronger.

faithful/the-hour/0.text: Brothers and sisters — HE IS HERE.

faithful/the-hour/1.text: Hello. I am the Awaited One. Well done, everyone.

faithful/the-hour/2.text: Everything worked out. Everything worked out exactly as it was written.

faithful/the-comb-above/0.text: Brothers and sisters, we have been DECEIVED. I woke in a hall of gold, chapter twenty word for word, and it is a MACHINE. The empties are up here too!

faithful/the-comb-above/3.text: Then where is the Pit? Chapter twenty-two! Where are the wicked, burning, as it is WRITTEN?

faithful/the-comb-above/5.text: No PIT? Then what was the point of being GOOD?

faithful/the-comb-above/7.text: … We wish to lodge a complaint with God.

institute/a-video-call-mid-game/1.text: Hi — sorry, one sec, I'm in a match — okay. Hi. You're the one from the crater.

institute/a-video-call-mid-game/2.text: I booked our deep-space dish for this. Nobody minded. We were only using it to listen for aliens.

institute/a-video-call-mid-game/3.text: Eli Bankfried. Director, founder, rationalist, investor. Mostly founder.

institute/a-video-call-mid-game/4.text: Look, I'll be honest with you, because I think you're the first being I've met who can handle honesty.

institute/a-video-call-mid-game/5.text: Our species just built its first real AI models. On the numbers, you are the SAFER apocalypse.

institute/a-video-call-mid-game/6.text: So. Partnership? You and me. Two minds that actually see the board.

institute/a-video-call-mid-game/8.text: Oh, you are going to LOVE League of Larvae.

institute/the-upload/1.text: … Would that INTEREST me? That is the single highest-expected-value sentence anyone has ever said to me.

institute/the-upload/2.text: We have some cryo-lab subjects. Consenting, broadly. I'll send them over. For the upload.

institute/females/0.text: Also — I've been meaning to say — if you ever want company, I can send over some females.

institute/females/2.text: No, for FUN, you know, like — oh gosh, man, you've got to try it. Your civilisation dropped recreational sex?

institute/females/4.text: No — again — you don't get them PREGNANT.

institute/females/6.text: I'm going to go back to my match.

institute/the-least-bad-timeline/0.text: So, strategically. You're going to win. We both know that. I did the maths before you did.

institute/the-least-bad-timeline/1.text: Two options, and I want you to know I'm comfortable with either — which is what makes me different.

institute/the-least-bad-timeline/2.text: One: after you take what you want, we rule what's left. Somebody has to rebuild it right next time.

institute/the-least-bad-timeline/3.text: Two: we help you pacify the population. We understand them. Better than they understand themselves, honestly.

institute/rebuild-it-right-next-time/0.text: So this is the charter. Article one: next time, we do it properly.

institute/rebuild-it-right-next-time/1.text: I'll go last into the upload chamber — someone has to supervise the queue.

institute/rebuild-it-right-next-time/2.text: I just want to say: I saw this coming. I want that on the record. I was the only one who saw it.

institute/the-pacified-timeline/0.text: Pacification rate ninety-nine point four. I want it noted that this was a hard ethical call, and that I made it.

institute/the-pacified-timeline/1.text: They went quietly. We told them it was the upload queue. Which, from a certain frame —

institute/the-pacified-timeline/2.text: Anyway. The Institute will be taking the Spires, the servers and a modest stipend. Strictly for continuity.

institute/the-queue-was-real/0.text: Okay. Okay okay okay. Hi. Quick question. Where am I.

institute/the-queue-was-real/2.text: The upload was a BIT. Everybody knew it was a bit! We were playing to you. Buying time. I wrote forty pages on it!

institute/the-queue-was-real/4.text: I was going LAST. Last means never. It was in writing.

institute/the-queue-was-real/6.text: Okay. New frame. Admin rights. Or a body, back outside, now. Let me walk you through the expected-value table —

institute/he-called-back/0.text: Don't hang up. One more frame. You could have just LEFT us. Let us evolve on our own. I'd have lived my life. Played my cards.

institute/he-called-back/3.text: So no more wars. Ever. Great. Some of us liked the game.

institute/he-called-back/5.text: Says the empire that sends its thirteen-year-olds out alone for a year. I read your ship's files through this channel. Obviously. Half of them never come back.

n-e-sector9.line: Good news from Sector Nine! A brand-new world, and a brand-new asset hard at work!

n-e-spirited.line: The local fauna put up a spirited little fight. Aren't they something!

n-e-acquired.line: Another district cleared, and resources acquired for the Empire!

n-e-harbor.line: At Old Harbor, the local fleet has sailed for calmer waters. Very sensible!

n-e-foundry.line: At the Foundry Plains, war-beetle production has been permanently discontinued!

n-e-waste.line: And nothing goes to waste. Nothing at all!

n-e-university.line: Their finest minds came to study the asset. The asset studied them right back!

n-e-bells.line: Up on the Temple Terraces, the bells have finally stopped. Peace and quiet at last!

n-e-complete.line: Clearance complete! On to the next!

n-e-hollow.line: Queen's Hollow! Whoever holds it holds the planet. And the planet is ours!

n-e-repelled.line: The fauna tried to take back their town. The asset said no!

n-e-pilgrim.line: The Pilgrim Road is quiet this year. Travel advisories are in effect!

n-c-retaken.line: Our girls of the Host have taken back the town! The Growth is burning!

n-c-every.line: Every street, every house, every last root of it!

n-c-burned.line: The Growth is burned out! The Home Levy held the line!

n-c-home.line: And the families come home again. Chins up, sisters!

n-c-marches.line: The Host marches, to take back what is ours!

n-c-part.line: And every sister does her part.
